name: git-worktree-safety
description: Git worktree pointers and SSH-signed commits recover fail-closed with redacted evidence, exact-state journals, one-use authorization, and explicit POSIX and host boundaries.

interface.shortDescription: Git pointers and SSH-signed commits recover fail-closed.
interface.longDescription: Git worktree pointers and SSH-signed commits recover under fail-closed, exact-state gates. Worktree recovery proves live branch identity and permits only tightly gated pointer repair; POSIX signing recovery keeps private evidence, atomically issues one helper authorization per state after a verified signer-state change, and verifies parent, diff, hook policy, signer identity, and residual worktree state.
capabilities: NUL-safe registered worktree inventory and exact branch binding
Branch-reachable, reflog-only, object-only, and missing commit classification
Clean symbolic replacement proof bound to the live branch ref
Broken convenience-symlink inspection with raw paths omitted from JSON
POSIX-only fingerprint and raw-target guarded exact symlink repair
Post-repair proof that relevant Git state remained unchanged
SSH-signed-commit snapshots with raw signing values omitted
Atomic one-use authorization per exact observed state
Post-commit parent, diff, hook, signer-identity, and residue verification
interface.defaultPrompt: Audit this Git recovery case and determine whether a pointer repair or one signed commit retry is safe.
